resources.string: UV Glow shows a violet light effect on your screen and can switch on your phone\'s normal white camera LED. It does not produce real ultraviolet (UV) light.
None. There is no account, no analytics, no ads and no tracking, and no data is shared with anyone.
Your settings, themes and presets are saved only on your phone. They may be included in your Android device backup if you have backup turned on.
The app only switches the camera LED on and off. It never takes photos or video and does not request the camera permission.
Premium subscriptions are handled by Google Play. We don\'t see or store your payment details. You can manage or cancel your subscription in Google Play.
UV Glow is not directed at children under 13, and it collects no data from anyone.
If anything changes, we\'ll update this page and the date at the top.
